title: Lignocellulosic biomass valorisation: a review of feedstocks, processes and potential value chains and their implications for the decision-making process
content:
RSC Sustain., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00342J, Tutorial Review

The complexity of lignocellulosic biomass valorisation was identified, and a novel assessment method is proposed to facilitate the decision-making process.
